description: Generates a random string of specified length from a given character set using a cryptographically secure random source. Returns the generated string. (cost: 1 credit)

characters.description: string, optional, character set to use for generation, default 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'

length.description: integer, required, length of the string to generate (must be positive)

name: generate_random_string
